grounded.note: every recorded output passed its code check; tests show a made-up quote, a line not in its file and a file not in the repo are rejected

rightPlaceStages.note: stages in product order; reached = the bundle's impact walk from its starting points (uncapped, 📜 included); shown = the bundle's pointers

nearbyWalk.note: starts from the real fix files (tests explaining, not finding); walk = the slice's own lines in reverse, shortest path, stopping at hubs; ties ranked by the D87 page index; no depth limit (withinOwnDepth flags picks past their page's slice depth); right page = D87's (own depth + 2), so 'lands on a right page' is close to guaranteed within that margin and a fresh agent judges whether page-gap picks are about the ticket; slice stops at shared components and endpoints not modelled
